setup.command: uv venv --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -r instrument_advisor/requirements-dev.txt

run.command: (python3 -m http.server 8000 --bind 0.0.0.0 >/dev/null 2>&1 &); cd instrument_advisor && exec ../.venv/bin/streamlit run app.py --server.port 8501 --server.address 0.0.0.0 --server.headless true --server.enableCORS false --server.enableXsrfProtection false
